# DataMind v2 — Data Intelligence & Multi-Agent Analytical Workspace
> High-performance decoupled analytical workspace powered by DuckDB, Apache Parquet, FastAPI, Next.js 15, and LangGraph multi-agent cognitive architecture.

## Overview
DataMind v2 transforms tabular datasets (CSV, Excel, Parquet) into actionable business intelligence, forensic diagnostics, and machine learning models in seconds.

## Core Capabilities
- **DuckDB + Parquet Analytical Engine**: Sub-millisecond vectorized queries on datasets up to millions of rows directly in-process with read-only sandbox isolation.
- **3-Tier Multi-Agent System**:
  - Tier 1: Instant SQL responses and data profiling (<100ms)
  - Tier 2: Analytical agents for correlation, outliers, trends, and forensic data quality checks
  - Tier 3: Bounded LangGraph multi-agent cognitive loops with hypothesis generation, verification, and automated ML
- **Autonomous AutoML Lab**: Automated problem framing (classification, regression, clustering, time-series), automated train/test split, stratified cross-validation, and multi-model benchmarking.
- **Self-Learning Episodic Memory**: Vector search via pgvector on prior user discoveries, feedback incorporation, and organizational analytical knowledge graphs.

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS, Plotly.js, Three.js
- Backend: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0 (Async), PostgreSQL 16 (pgvector), DuckDB, Redis 7, Taskiq
- AI Models: Local Ollama (qwen2.5-coder:7b), Gemini Flash/Pro, LiteLLM
